title: Automate changelog and onboard meridian-lite-6b v1.0 (metadata + perf profiles)
author: Aisha Kapoor
description: Motivation: Add Meridian Lite 6B v1.0 to the model registry with full metadata and validated performance profiles, and wire the changelog automation pipeline to publish release notes when a model is onboarded. This PR adds the model metadata, the perf profile YAML generated from the perf lab, CI checks that validate performance thresholds and schema, and a small automation script to append structured release notes to the changelog when the PR is merged. Checklist: 1) Add model metadata and manifest; 2) Add perf profiles generated from benchmark-lab runs; 3) Add CI perf checks and schema validation; 4) Add changelog automation hook and template; 5) Add model docs and examples; 6) Tests for metadata parsing and perf threshold gating; 7) Update registry index. Implementation notes: - metadata file follows our schema including model_name, family, parameters, quantization_profiles, recommended_batching and default_sequence_lengths. - perf profile contains throughput and latency percentiles for sequence lengths 32/128/512 on target GPU families (A100, H100) and quantized paths. We include KV-cache/streaming notes and a short note on recommended batch sizes for different latency SLOs. - generate_release_notes.py is intentionally small: it loads the new metadata/perf files, renders the release note template with the structured fields, and appends an entry to models/CHANGELOG.md in a machine-friendly block for downstream consumption by the website build. - CI: ci/perf-checks/meridian-lite-6b.yml runs a lightweight perf sanity test in the perf-canary cluster (smoke) and validates thresholds. - Tests: tests/model-registry/test_meridian_metadata.py validates required fields and ensures perf-profile keys exist and are within expected ranges. Migration notes: None. Rollout: merged to main, changelog automation will create a release note entry and trigger a docs site rebuild to surface the model page. Related: ENG-3421 (onboarding flow), ENG-3499 (changelog automation), SUP-1123 (customer support ticket referencing model availability).
commits: Add meridian-lite-6b v1.0 metadata and manifest
Add perf profiles from perf-lab runs for 32/128/512 sequence lengths
Add CI perf sanity workflow and schema validator
Add release notes generator and CHANGELOG template block
Add docs page and unit tests
review_comments: Samir Patel: Please include recommended batch_size per GPU family in the perf profile so customers can map to our Dedicated configs. Response: Added recommended_batching section to perf-profiles.yaml with per-GPU guidance.

Emily Wong: The changelog generator looks good but can we ensure it writes an idempotent block so repeated runs don't duplicate entries? Response: Generator writes a unique block marker based on model name+version and replaces an existing block if present.

Jorge Martinez: CI perf thresholds are strict for H100 80K tokens/sec baseline, we should gate by flavor (quantized vs fp16). Response: Adjusted thresholds by path and added separate checks for quantized/FP16 paths.
Samir Patel: Minor nits on docs formatting; please add an example request/response showing function-calling metadata. Response: Added example to docs and a short snippet in metadata manifest.
release_notes: - Onboarded Meridian Lite 6B v1.0: production-ready 6B model optimized for low-latency use cases with quantized and FP16 execution paths. - Added structured metadata and performance profiles (A100/H100) covering seq-len 32/128/512 including p50/p90/p99 latencies and recommended batching guidance. - CI perf sanity checks ensure perf regressions are gated and changelog automation will generate release notes on merge.
notes_for_operators: Perf profile highlights: p50 latency ~24ms @ seq32 quantized on H100, recommended_batching: H100: [batch=16 for <100ms SLO], A100: [batch=8 for <100ms SLO]. Automation: changelog generator appends machine-friendly block to models/CHANGELOG.md and emits a short JSON snippet for the docs pipeline.
testing_summary: Unit tests added for metadata schema, perf profile key validation, and changelog idempotency. Perf smoke CI ran against a canary cluster with representative inputs and passed thresholds defined in ci/perf-checks/meridian-lite-6b.yml.
user_impact: Available immediately via model-registry API after deployment. No breaking changes. Documentation page added with example prompts and recommended config for Dedicated and Private deployments.
